recent.message:
Restyle the dashboard as a GitLab-style release-proof workspace

Breadcrumb header, sidebar (Overview, Release runs, Models, Duo assessments)
with external GitLab links, hash-routed views, and a compact decision panel
that states the numbers ("0.1421 observed > 0.05 allowed"). Each run has a
detail view: decision, policy checks, metrics, artifact identity, sources.
Evidence pages state the numeric reason too.

Scheduled dashboard-refresh pipelines are now out of scope instead of being
counted as missing evidence.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

recent.message:
Restore equal-opportunity calibration in build_variant_d

build_variant_d in demo-model/train.py fit the base logistic regression but
then used a single global threshold {0: 0.5, 1: 0.5} for both groups, so no
equal-opportunity calibration was applied. Variants A and B compute per-group
thresholds with _equal_opportunity_thresholds; this restores the same step.

Thresholds are derived from the training data only (data/train.csv, via the
train_df passed to the builder). Evaluation data is not read. No policy,
threshold, validation code or Witness change. The effect is not verified
here; CI and the Witness decide on the new pipeline.
recent.title: Restore equal-opportunity calibration in build_variant_d

Compute the base model's training-set probabilities and derive per-group
thresholds with _equal_opportunity_thresholds from data/train.csv labels and
groups, as variants A and B do. No evaluation data is read. No threshold,
policy or Witness change.

agents.statement: Agents advise, the Witness decides, people release.

flows.name: Impact Analyst
flows.when: When a merge request is created
flows.does: Reads a merge request's diff and posts one advisory note with its scope, risk and the evidence it expects.
flows.why_trigger: It only reads a diff and writes one note, so running it on every merge request is cheap and harmless.

flows.name: Release Investigator
flows.when: When a pipeline fails (or when mentioned with a pipeline ID)
flows.does: Checks whether the release gate failed. If so, records one evidence-backed investigation issue; if not, posts one short note and stops.
flows.why_trigger: Read-only plus one issue. Its first step is a triage, so a failure outside the release gate costs one short note.

flows.name: Release Repair
flows.when: Only when a person mentions it on an investigation issue
flows.does: Proposes a code change as a draft merge request. It cannot approve, merge or deploy.
flows.why_trigger: It changes code, so a person reads the investigation first and decides a repair is worth making.

history.title: Prove model-hash-from-image mechanism; add synthetic data and models A-D

classification_changes.change: LICENSE is classified as documentation, so a licence-only change no longer needs the full model evidence set.

controls.disclosure: Aligned with these frameworks at the level of themes. Not certified, audited or assessed against any of them; nothing here is a statement of compliance.

items.name: Deterministic gate
items.does: A program with no model in it decides: it re-derives the model hash, image digest, data, policy and commit identity and blocks on any mismatch or missing input.
items.slsa: Verification of build inputs before release (not a SLSA level)

items.name: Recompute-verify
items.does: The Witness recomputes accuracy and fairness from the exact model, twice, and blocks a claimed number that differs.

items.name: Sigstore keyless signing
items.does: The evidence bundle and provenance are signed with the GitLab CI identity; no key is stored.
items.slsa: Signed provenance (self-generated, no SLSA level claimed)

items.name: Rekor transparency log
items.does: Each signature is recorded in the public Sigstore transparency log.

items.name: MR-approval separation of duties
items.does: A change merges only after a recorded approval.
items.slsa: Two-person review is not met with one member
items.status_detail: 4 merge requests with an approval record; 4 are self-approvals (single-member demo project)

items.name: Immutable evidence
items.does: Evidence artifacts of new runs are kept without expiry; blocked releases stay listed with their reason.
items.status_detail: Evidence jobs keep artifacts without expiry; runs before that change expire after 90 days

items.name: Runtime digest check
items.does: After the release job, a separate job re-downloads the published model and compares its digest with the signed evidence. An artifact-integrity check, not a live-inference test.
items.slsa: Deployed artifact matches the attested subject digest
items.status_detail: 12 runs with the artifact digest verified

items.name: Scheduled re-verification
items.does: Re-runs the recomputation on a fixed holdout and flags drift. Not live production-traffic monitoring.
items.status_detail: No scheduled re-verification yet. Create a weekly schedule on main; see docs/SETUP.md.

items.name: Duo as advisory
items.does: Duo flows investigate and propose; they cannot approve, merge or deploy.
items.status_detail: 5 Duo assessments recorded next to the Witness result
